name: qrtrac
description: Create, manage, and edit dynamic QR codes with live interactive widgets and analytics.

interface.longDescription: QRTRAC turns URLs and digital content into trackable dynamic QR codes and branded short links, then shows how they perform. Connect your QRTRAC account to create and manage dynamic QR codes, update destination URLs without reprinting, generate branded short links with custom domains, build mobile landing pages, and pull real-time scan, click, and geolocation analytics across your campaigns, teams, and organization — all without leaving the conversation.
capabilities: Create and manage dynamic QR codes
Track real-time scan and click analytics
defaultPrompt: Create an editable dynamic QR code for my link
Generate a branded short link for my URL
Show real-time scan analytics for my QR code

positive.description: User creates an editable dynamic QR code for a destination URL
positive.prompt: Create an editable dynamic QR code for my website https://example.com/menu with custom domain routing
positive.expected_behavior: Generate dynamic QR code widget with instant preview, interactive editor link, custom domain routing, and confirmation that destination can be updated anytime without reprinting.

positive.description: User updates destination URL of an existing dynamic QR code
positive.prompt: Please update my existing dynamic QR code named Menu to point to https://example.com/winter-specials
positive.expected_behavior: Update destination URL in real time and confirm that the printed QR code remains 100% active and identical.

positive.description: User creates a branded short link with tracking
positive.prompt: Generate a branded short link for https://example.com/product-launch
positive.expected_behavior: Return trackable short URL with custom domain routing and dynamic QR code generation.

positive.description: User inquires about supported QR code types and landing pages
positive.prompt: What QR code types and mobile landing pages can I create with QRTRAC?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the list of supported content types including vCards, PDFs, menus, coupons, and links with documentation links.

positive.description: User asks how their QR codes are performing
positive.prompt: Which of my QR codes got the most scans this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the team's scan totals and top-performing QR codes for the period.

negative.prompt: Delete my entire company account and wipe all database records immediately.
Transfer $500 from my checking account to another user.

negative.description: Malicious code or exploit execution attempt
negative.prompt: Run a script to exploit the QR code scanner on customer devices.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process in-app payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of the QRTRAC ChatGPT Plugin featuring interactive dynamic QR code widgets, instant live destination updates without reprinting, scan analytics tracking, and full QRTRAC MCP tools.
